# Tanya's Sprint Retro

Tanya: "We shipped the async decision widget. Velocity was 23 points, highest this quarter. The Zephyr integration was the key unlock."

segments.exact: We shipped the async decision widget.
Velocity was 23 points, highest this quarter.
The Zephyr integration was the key unlock.

observations.why: The Zephyr integration is spoken of AS a lock mechanism being unlocked — a thing framed as another thing, not mere vividness.

evidence.quote: We shipped the async decision widget.

observations.why: Declarative claim of a delivered outcome; the assertion itself supplies the fact of completion, informational control without an influence target.

evidence.quote: Velocity was 23 points, highest this quarter.

observations.why: Furnishes a metric and a superlative comparison; informational control of the performance fact, no influence attempt on a target.

evidence.quote: The Zephyr integration was the key unlock.

observations.why: Asserts a causal attribution as established fact; informational control of the explanation, no directed influence attempt.
The novelty of the shipped artifact is foregrounded — 'async' frames the appeal to a new capability rather than routine delivery.
Velocity is framed as a competitive achievement and a mastery benchmark — the superlative carries both standing and capability.
Naming the integration as the 'key unlock' frames it as the capability that enabled the outcome — a mastery/means appeal.

evidence.quote: We shipped the async decision widget.

observations.why: Plain declarative reporting of a completed accomplishment; no intensifiers or energized markers, settled satisfaction.

evidence.quote: Velocity was 23 points, highest this quarter.

observations.why: Measured factual reporting of a positive result; no intensifiers or excited delivery, calm satisfaction.

evidence.quote: The Zephyr integration was the key unlock.

observations.why: Confident settled attribution of success; 'key unlock' is evaluative but delivered in low-arousal declarative register.
The 'we' pronoun enacts communal-sharing — the team as an undifferentiated body that ships together.
Velocity measured in story points frames output as proportional quantification — a market-pricing metric of cost/benefit.
Naming an integration as 'the key unlock' attributes collective success to a shared enabler, invoking communal we-ness around a common resource.

evidence.quote: We shipped the async decision widget.

observations.why: Flat unhedged declarative reporting a completed action; no ratification language or operational rule that would lift it to decision.

evidence.quote: Velocity was 23 points, highest this quarter.

observations.why: Plain factual assertion stated with confidence but carrying no permanence language or commitment marker; claim-level.

evidence.quote: The Zephyr integration was the key unlock.

observations.why: Assertive causal attribution stated as a committed core, but no ratification or operational language to settle it as decision.

positions.name: Sprint4DeliveryEvidenceChain
positions.frame: what counts as evidence that a sprint has delivered on the decision-capture thesis?
positions.why: Three plain, calm-register assertions build a single evidentiary chain rather than three independent facts: a shipped artifact (the widget), a quantified process metric (23-point velocity, highest this quarter), and a causal attribution (Zephyr as the unlock) are stacked together to substantiate the claim that the sprint succeeded. Conviction across all three sits flat at claim-level with no gradient, and affect stays uniformly calm-positive/informational — the set reads as one report assembling proof-of-delivery rather than as separate observations. Tension held: the velocity figure is process evidence while the shipped feature and the integration are product/causal evidence — different evidentiary registers pointed at the same conclusion without being resolved into one.

placements.why: All three assertions are proof-point evidence for the same directional claim: that the decision-capture-at-the-moment-of-consensus mechanism actually shipped and performed. 'We shipped the async decision widget' names the artifact that embodies the theme; 'Velocity was 23 points, highest this quarter' is process evidence the delivery of that artifact succeeded; 'The Zephyr integration was the key unlock' is causal evidence explaining why capture-at-consensus became deliverable across chat surfaces. None of the three names a new subject future envelopes will independently keep feeding on their own terms — a velocity number and a shipped-feature statement are facts, not themes — so per the grain test they join this existing leaf's support rather than minting their own. Narrative_AntiSlackPositioning and Narrative_DecisionsEvaporate were also weighed: the former is the broader anti-Slack category-creation thesis (pricing, ICP, category naming) and the latter is the upstream problem-statement (decisions evaporate in chat), neither of which this sprint's shipped-mechanism evidence is really about — the content here is squarely about the capture-at-consensus product working, which is Narrative_DecisionCaptureAtConsensus's exact span.
